messages:
maria: Quick sync for next release announce. Marketing needs final changelog URL, canonical docs landing, one-line benchmark blurb for hero, locked webinar CTA, and exact canary start so we can schedule the mailer and socials. @aj @noah @sara

aj: Changelog draft done internally. Will push public page by 18:30 PT and drop the link here. Waiting on one small header fix.

noah: Docs are merged to main. Ops needs to flip the redirect. Proposed canonical: https://docs.redwood.inference/release/2026-09. Ops, can you flip at 08:20 PT on release day?

ops-lead: Can do 08:20 PT. Canary plan: 08:30 PT 10% for 15m, then 30% for 20m, full ramp 09:05 PT. Rollback triggers: p95 latency > 300ms or error rate > 1% sustained for 3m. I'll schedule and monitor.

sara: CTA options: "Join our 9/15 webinar to see the benchmarks" or "See the performance story 1 register for 9/15 webinar". Prefer the first for clarity. Need locked copy by 15:00 PT to build the mailer.

maria: Locking CTA #1. Benchmark blurb suggestion: "Up to 2.7x faster p95 with material cost reductions on common chat flows." Keep it short and link to the appendix.

aj: I'll include a short benchmark appendix in the changelog with test harness and seeds. Public changelog link will include that artifact.

noah: For inbound routing, landing page path will be /r/sep_release and utm_campaign=sep_release. Segment event name: "release_sep_signup". Sample payload I'll paste in docs.

ops-lead: deploy-bot: queue docs-redirect for 2026-09-15T15:20:00Z (08:20 PT) and canary-rollout for 2026-09-15T15:30:00Z (08:30 PT). Monitoring hooks: perf-alerts, error-rate, rollout-audit.

deploy-bot: [scheduled] docs-redirect queued; canary-rollout queued; will post status updates.

maria: Final checklist: changelog link by 18:30 PT (aj), docs canonical live at 08:20 PT (ops), CTA locked (sara), benchmark blurb (maria/aj), canary schedule (ops). If all confirmed I'll lock email send at 09:15 PT only if canary green by 09:00.

aj: Confirmed, pushing public changelog now.

noah: Confirmed, will post Segment payload and landing details to docs.

sara: Confirmed, will drop final email copy at 14:45 PT for quick review.

ops-lead: Confirmed. I'll post canary progress and escalate if thresholds breach.

maria: Thanks everyone 72 keep updates in this thread and tag @maria if anything slips.
